persons.name: Ananta
persons.evidence: śrīmān ananto mudā, yatnā pūrṇṇatamaṃ lilekha

date.as_written: śunyarandhragirau tadā pragaṇite nepālasamvatsare, jyeṣṭhakāmatihau sitetaratare pakṣe nabhauṣetrabhe(!)

notes: Year 790 expressed in chronogram (śūnya = 0, randhra = 9, giri = 7). Kāmatithi corresponds to the 13th tithi (trayodaśī). Sitetaratara indicates the dark fortnight (kṛṣṇapakṣa).
